script = '''
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import openpyxl

# Perform OCR on the invoice image
img = Image.open("uploads/invoice.png")
text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

print("=== OCR EXTRACTED TEXT ===")
print(text)
print("=========================")

# Create a new Excel workbook
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice OCR"

# Write each line of extracted text into a separate row
lines = text.splitlines()
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=line)

# Auto-adjust column width for readability
max_len = max((len(line) for line in lines), default=10)
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = min(max_len + 2, 120)

output_path = "output/invoice_ocr.xlsx"
import os
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"\\nExcel file saved to: {output_path}")
'''
await write_file("./ocr_script.py", script)
print("Script written.")
